Meta Ads Weekly Report: BillyDoe Meats

Overall Performance

  • Total Spend: $322.48
  • Impressions: 20,505
  • Reach: 4,670
  • CPM: $15.73
  • Link Clicks: 145
  • CTR: 0.71%
  • CPC: $2.22
  • Landing Page Views: 116 ($2.78 each)
  • Purchases: 9
  • Cost per Purchase: $35.83
  • Purchase Value: $1,083.54
  • ROAS: 3.36

Performance Summary

  • I spent $322.48 this week and the account returned $1,083.54 in purchase value, which is a ROAS of 3.36. Last week's ROAS was 7.15.
  • Both campaigns produced sales, but the Muslims campaign did most of the work. It took 51% of the spend and brought in 83% of the purchase value.
  • The Others campaign returned $185.14 on $156.78 spent (ROAS 1.18) and cost $78.39 per purchase. Only 66% of its clicks became landing page views, against 93% on the Muslims campaign.
  • Frequency is high in both campaigns (3.35 and 3.99), so I will keep an eye on ad fatigue.

Campaign Performance

BWS - Sales - Muslims

  • Spend: $165.70
  • Impressions: 10,400 | Reach: 3,108 | Frequency: 3.35
  • CPM: $15.93
  • Link Clicks: 74 | CTR: 0.71% | CPC: $2.24
  • Landing Page Views: 69 ($2.40 each)
  • Add to Cart: 20
  • Purchases: 7 at $23.67 each
  • Purchase Value: $898.40 | ROAS: 5.42

This campaign is working well. Cost per purchase is low and 93% of clicks reach the website.

BWS - Sales - Others

  • Spend: $156.78
  • Impressions: 10,105 | Reach: 2,534 | Frequency: 3.99
  • CPM: $15.52
  • Link Clicks: 71 | CTR: 0.70% | CPC: $2.21
  • Landing Page Views: 47 ($3.34 each)
  • Add to Cart: 8
  • Purchases: 2 at $78.39 each
  • Purchase Value: $185.14 | ROAS: 1.18

This campaign cost more than three times as much per purchase as the Muslims campaign, and fewer of its clicks reached the website. It is the weak point of the account this week.

Overall Summary

The account is still returning more than it spends, but ROAS is well down on last week (3.36 against 7.15). The Muslims campaign is carrying the results and I will keep most of the budget there. For the Others campaign I will refresh the creatives to bring frequency down, and I will look at why so many clicks are not reaching the landing page before I decide how much budget it keeps.
